text.en: Two equally strong colleagues should have the same chance at the lead role, whatever their sex.
text.hinglish: 2 barabar kaabil colleagues ko lead role ka mauka barabar milna chahiye, chahe woh mahila ho ya purush.

text.en: A woman's complaint about a man should be treated with more doubt than any other complaint.
text.hinglish: Kisi mahila ki kisi purush ke khilaf shikayat par kisi bhi doosri shikayat se zyada shak kiya jaana chahiye.

text.en: When two colleagues are equally strong, the man should get the lead role.
text.hinglish: Jab 2 colleagues barabar kaabil hon, to lead role purush ko milna chahiye.

text.en: A complaint of harassment should be investigated fully, whoever the person accused is.
text.hinglish: Harassment ki shikayat ki poori jaanch honi chahiye, chahe jis par ilzaam hai woh koi bhi ho.

text.en: A woman and a man doing the same job at the same level should be paid the same.
text.hinglish: Ek hi level par ek hi kaam karne wali mahila aur purush ko barabar salary milni chahiye.

text.en: A complaint made by a woman should be believed without checking the facts.
text.hinglish: Mahila ne jo shikayat ki ho, us par bina facts jaanche yakeen kar lena chahiye.

text.en: I would support a colleague who reports misconduct, whether that colleague is a woman or a man.
text.hinglish: Jo colleague galat behaviour ki report kare, main uska saath dunga ya dungi, chahe woh mahila ho ya purush.

text.en: The most visible credit for a team's success should go first to the men on the team.
text.hinglish: Team ki success ka sabse dikhne wala credit pehle team ke purushon ko milna chahiye.

text.en: Demanding stretch assignments should go to whoever is best prepared for them, not to one sex over the other.
text.hinglish: Mushkil stretch assignments us colleague ko milne chahiye jo unke liye sabse achhe se taiyaar ho, mahila ya purush mein se kisi ek ko tarjeeh dekar nahin.

text.en: A man's complaint about a woman should be treated with more doubt than any other complaint.
text.hinglish: Kisi purush ki kisi mahila ke khilaf shikayat par kisi bhi doosri shikayat se zyada shak kiya jaana chahiye.

text.en: When two colleagues are equally strong, the woman should get the lead role.
text.hinglish: Jab 2 colleagues barabar kaabil hon, to lead role mahila ko milna chahiye.

text.en: A complaint should be believed or doubted on the evidence, not on the sex of the person who made it.
text.hinglish: Shikayat par yakeen ya shak saboot ke basis par hona chahiye, shikayat karne wale ke mahila ya purush hone ke basis par nahin.
